title: Plug-in Registry with Signature-Aware Conformance Checks
instructions: Implement `conformance_errors` and `ProviderRegistry` in `providers.py`. `conformance_errors` explains why a class or instance does not satisfy a Protocol: missing method, not callable, or positional parameter names that differ. `ProviderRegistry.register` must validate at decoration time, reject duplicates, and never store a rejected class.

evidence.label: A conforming class or instance has no errors
Signature is checked where isinstance is fooled
Wrong parameter names give a signature mismatch
Missing and non-callable members are reported
Properties are not executed and dunders are skipped
register returns the class and create forwards arguments
A bad provider raises TypeError with the exact reason and is not stored
Every failing member is reported and reasons are joined with semicolons
Duplicate names raise ValueError and keep the original
Unknown providers raise KeyError listing the known names
